newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian, German cosmonauts arrive at Baikonur.
newsitem.headline: Russian, German cosmonauts arrive at Baikonur.

text.p: Six Russian and German cosmonauts flew to Baikonur cosmodrome in Kazakhstan on Wednesday ahead of a mission to the Russian Mir space station, a space official said.

Vasili Tsibliev, 42, Alexander Lazutkin, 39, and German cosmonaut Ewald Reinhold, 40, due for launch on February 10, flew into the snow-covered Baikonur complex on a separate flight from a backup crew. The main crew is expected to get the go-ahead for launch a day before the mission is due to start.
Reinhold is scheduled to stay aboard Mir for 20 days before returning to Earth with the current Mir crew, Valery Korzun and Alexander Koleri. They have manned the station for six months.
U.S. astronaut Jerry Linenger, who began to work at the station on January 15, will return to Earth in June.
